tells.1: A formulaic reassurance pair ('None of this means a plan is wrong for you. It just deserves a close read...') followed by a polished soft-sell closer.
tells.2: The tidy 'You're welcome to leave with nothing more than a clearer idea of your options' closer. Otherwise it reads naturally.
tells.3: The hedge-then-reassure pattern ('None of this means... It just deserves a close read of the small print first'), set in one evenly polished block.
tells.5: Long, symmetrically balanced sentences ('None of this means a plan is wrong for you, only that it deserves...') with uniform smooth cadence throughout.
tells.6: Near-identical to 3: the same hedged 'None of this means...' reassurance and the same uniformly smooth phrasing.
tells.7: The stilted inversion 'the provider's terms alter' and the neatly balanced 'for some families they are. Others will be better off without one.'

reason: Version 4 has the typos, run-ons and clunky phrasing of a genuine human draft, but it isn't publishable as is. Version 2 keeps all its content in clear, natural, well-paragraphed prose without overworked rhythm, so it is the best one to send.
